name: Vow ecosystem

subjectOf.text: Integrating stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies gives a token ecosystem a stable transactional medium and mitigates the volatility that otherwise attaches to cryptocurrencies, alongside DeFi services that let users earn returns and access credit outside the banking system.
subjectOf.abstract: The integration of stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies provides a stable medium for transactions, mitigating the volatility often associated with cryptocurrencies.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
scope_conditions: the VOW ecosystem as a case study

subjectOf.text: A reputation governance layer that awards reputation tokens for contributions and behavior fosters trust and drives positive engagement within a token community, complementing DAO based token holder voting.
subjectOf.abstract: the VOW ecosystem incorporates a reputation governance system, which rewards users with reputation tokens based on their contributions and behavior.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
scope_conditions: the VOW ecosystem as a case study

subjectOf.text: An operating token ecosystem such as VOW can function as empirical evidence for quantum economics, since a working decentralized system that manages complex economic phenomena supports the validity and utility of the abstract framework it instantiates.
subjectOf.abstract: The practical success of the VOW ecosystem can serve as empirical evidence supporting the validity and utility of quantum economics, fostering greater acceptance and adoption of quantum principles in economic theory and practice.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
scope_conditions: conditional on the continued practical success of the ecosystem
